exposure: Labor with any method of delivery
cohort: Women who gave birth between 1988 and 2006 in Nova Scotia, Canada
finding: Women who underwent a Cesarean section without labor in their first pregnancy had a reduced risk of developing pelvic floor health disorders over time, even after multiple deliveries.
mod_finding: Cesarean section without labor was associated with a reduced risk of all studied pelvic floor disorders except fistula formation.
